name: Gami-Fied
description: Self-hosted gamification engine for points, badges, levels and leaderboards in your apps.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database (postgres/), Redis (redis/), backups (backups/) and the secret keys (state/). Back up the whole folder: without state/secrets.env, stored credentials and webhook secrets can't be read.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Gami.Fied dashboard and API (/api, /v1), published on host as 6709

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6709, or use your https domain. Sign-in only works on this address, and your apps send events to it.
